title: Audit every decision rule and review metric that grades on mean net R alone (exit-lever gate RULE-M20-EXIT-LEVER-IS-OOS-GATE, promotion rules, perf-review headline, LTR hold-vs-option, desk lifecycle) and propose the risk-adjusted form under the operator's 2026-10-29 objective (net P&L first, risk second; a big risk cut for a small R cost wins)
note: Origin: operator 2026-10-29 ~06:35Z, verbatim on row AM-RISK-ADJUSTED-RULE. Depends on AM-RISK-ADJUSTED-RULE landing the named rule (RULE-AM-RISK-ADJUSTED-V1) first, so this reuses it rather than inventing a second one. Output: one table, rule -> current criterion -> proposed risk-adjusted criterion -> which past verdicts would flip (re-grade, not re-run); every change stays a Tier-3 proposal.
